subtitle: Lesson 19 · Training Deep Networks in Practice

eyebrow: Clip the gradient norm, between backward and step
code:
loss = loss_fn(model(x), y)
loss.backward()

torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
    model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0
)

optimizer.step()
optimizer.zero_grad()
caption: Rescales all gradients proportionally -- direction is preserved.

code:
torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_value_(
    model.parameters(), clip_value=0.5
)

# clamps each gradient element to
# [-0.5, 0.5] independently -- can
# change the gradient's direction
caption: Norm clipping is the more common default; value clipping is cruder.
